items.title: 197 passing tests, four real-hardware bugs
items.hard_result: 197 passing unit tests preceded four defects exposed by real RDMA execution

items.title: When uncertainty makes active learning worse
items.hard_result: Greedy DAF 5.15 vs UCB 5.17 at lambda=0.5; uncertainty-error Spearman correlation -0.47; high uncertainty weight collapses DAF to 0.91
items.known_rival: The failure may be specific to output-layer MC dropout, this OOD proxy task, or this pretrained surrogate rather than uncertainty-aware acquisition generally

history.note: Published after narrowing the claim to static acquisition screening, adding calibration diagnostics, a high-lambda robustness test, primary literature context, and explicit rival explanations.

items.title: I built a security benchmark and discovered it was leaking the answers
items.hard_result: 13 of 24 prompts contained severe/moderate contamination in the original audit; the zero-cost sanitizer/preflight now locks the 16+5+3 population and clean anon condition
items.claim_boundary: Do not claim the sanitized model score or causal size of the contamination effect because the paid raw/stripped/anon inference rerun is intentionally not being run

items.title: Upstreaming uncertainty: from an experiment to a reusable MatGL primitive
items.hard_result: MCDropoutWrapper was accepted upstream; the backbone-once path reports about 16.5x speedup at 20 passes on RTX 3080 while retaining numerical equivalence

items.title: Autograd is part of the API
items.hard_result: A tensor-native SoftExponential fix removed branching-related autograd failure and guarded NaN/Inf gradients; patch merged upstream

items.title: The sampler default that could mask a token distribution
items.hard_result: Merged MLX-LM XTC default fix prevented a pathological configuration from masking nearly the entire candidate token distribution

items.title: Recursive types without mutual recursion
items.hard_result: Merged Alloy EIP-712 fix distinguished legal self-reference from illegal mutual recursion and added targeted regression coverage

items.title: Date and time bugs are systems bugs
items.hard_result: Multiple merged GNU-compatibility fixes cover timezone re-zoning, negative fractional Unix timestamps, AM/PM parsing, and UT timezone handling

items.title: From simulated proof to live invariant
items.hard_result: Use concrete bridge invariants, proof-validation boundaries, and live verification artifacts rather than product claims

items.title: Building an airborne drone carrier by deleting the science-fiction parts first
items.blocker: Needs physical P0 capture/recovery telemetry before performance claims can be promoted from target to observed result
items.allowed_fallback: May publish a clearly labeled design note without achieved-performance claims
items.unblock_condition: Commit instrumented recovery dataset and acceptance-gate results

items.title: What upstream maintainers taught me about correctness
items.hard_result: Synthesize only accepted upstream patches and clearly separate merged evidence from closed or still-open attempts
